title: Swappable Claude Profiles: Per-Project Configs via Container Mounting (Part 3)

chapters.title: Cloud code isolation with host folder mounting
Creating a specialized AL repository summarizer agent
Swapping projects with container mounting and authentication
Plugin configuration and LSP navigation setup
Commands vs Skills: Modern agent skills framework
Supporting files, sub-agents and custom agent configuration
Rethinking AL development profile architecture and future work
General readiness, issue reporting and closing remarks

features.name: Host folder mounting for cloud configuration
features.description: Instead of persisting cloud JSON in a Docker volume, configurations are persisted into a host config folder that can be mounted into containers for project-specific profiles.
caveats: Requires manual folder setup
Sensitive credential information is cached in the host folder

features.name: AL repository summarizer agent
features.description: A specialized agent that can be created to summarize AL repositories and provide human-readable overviews of AL project structures without reading every line of code.
caveats: Experimental use case
Effectiveness may vary

features.name: Agent memory and automatic persistence
features.description: Agents automatically create and persist memory files in user-specific directories, storing conversation history and context that can be reused across sessions.
caveats: Memory files may contain sensitive information
Requires manual exploration to understand structure

features.name: Container-based project switching with cloud code
features.description: Ability to mount different folders as projects and connect to different projects using cloud code with separate authentication and credential management.
caveats: Requires re-authentication when switching projects
Behavior of running with different authentications unclear

features.name: Per-folder MCP server configuration
features.description: Ability to load MCP servers like Waldo's telemetry MCP server into any folder structure with folder-specific settings and instructions without needing to care about AL-specific instructions.
caveats: Currently using dedicated telemetry folder across all projects
Requires manual setup per folder

features.name: LSP code navigation plugin
features.description: A plugin from Corpin Le that enables code navigation and related features, configurable via environment variables in container configuration.
caveats: Requires environment variable setup
LSP tool must be enabled globally
Marketplace linking and cloning requires manual setup or external GitHub connection
Had issues with GitHub access restrictions in container

features.name: Skills framework for AI development
features.description: Modern replacement for the legacy commands approach using agent skills standard, supporting markdown-based skill definitions that can run in isolated sub-processes with automatic model invocation.
caveats: Commands are the legacy approach
No built-in skill generator
Model invocation can be disabled

features.name: Skill context configuration
features.description: Skills can be configured with context options that can be set to either omitted or fork mode. Context configuration affects how tools are restricted and available to skills.
caveats: Context options behavior may be counterintuitive

features.name: Supporting files in skills
features.description: Skills can include supporting files and helper scripts beyond the main skill markdown file. This allows utility scripts and user-invocable functions to be organized without cluttering slash commands.
caveats: Requires proper organization to maintain focus

features.name: Sub-agents for skills
features.description: Skills can be configured to use dedicated custom sub-agents for execution. When the main Claude session runs a skill, it automatically uses the sub-agent defined within the skill configuration.
caveats: Requires careful specification of skill documentation versus sub-agent instructions
Architecture complexity increases with this approach

features.name: Commands to skills migration pattern
features.description: Existing AL development profiles that used sub-agents and commands can be refactored to use skills instead. This changes the architecture as skills can now be pre-configured with sub-agent usage.
caveats: Requires rethinking profile architecture
Needs clarification on skill documentation versus sub-agent instructions boundaries

features.name: Swappable Claude profiles per project via container mounting
features.description: A container-based system allowing developers to configure and use swappable Claude profiles on a per-project basis through container mounting. The base container is considered stable and ready for general purpose usage.
caveats: Some known issues with marketplace functionality remain
Users may encounter problems requiring issue reporting
Container base will not change much but is subject to fixes
